COURSE

Web Security Foundations

A complete 4-module foundation: start with HTTP and trust boundaries, protect sessions and authorization, eliminate SQL injection and XSS, and harden CSRF, SSRF, uploads, and production APIs.

BeginnerLevel
4Modules
12Lessons
~5hEst. time
0%Progress
0 of 12 lessons completed
Start course
WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

By the end of this course, you will understand:

  • Map assets and trust boundaries in a web application and read raw HTTP requests and responses.
  • Explain how authentication, session management, and server-side object authorization differ.
  • Identify SQL injection, reflected/stored/DOM XSS, CSRF, and SSRF failure modes and apply structural defenses.
  • Configure defensive file-upload controls, HTTP security headers, CORS policies, and API rate limiting.
Who this course is for & prerequisites

Beginners, students, and developers who want to understand web security before studying individual vulnerabilities.

Before you start

  • Comfort using a web browser and navigating websites.
  • No previous security-testing experience required. Basic HTML is helpful, not required.

Injection, XSS & Client-Side Defenses
